<thought>Based on the formula C6H15NO2, DBE = 0, three methyl groups, two hydroxyl groups and one amine, a plausible structure is HO‑CH2‑CH(NH2)‑CH2‑C(CH3)2‑OH. This molecule can be viewed as three connected fragments: a hydroxymethyl fragment, an amino‑alkyl fragment, and a tert‑butyl‑alcohol fragment. Their SMILES strings are “CO”, “C(N)C”, and “C(C)(C)O”.</thought>
<final_answer>['CO', 'C(N)C', 'C(C)(C)O']</final_answer>
